title: Integer coefficients of a Boolean function
statement: Given a function $f$ from the $n$-dimensional binary cube to the two-element field and a set $S$ of coordinates, define an integer by summing over all subsets $T\subseteq S$: include $(-1)^{|S|-|T|}$ when $f$ is $1$ at the binary vector whose $1$-coordinates are exactly $T$, and include $0$ otherwise.
